messages:
Jade (support): Heads-up — multiple enterprise customers reporting streaming sessions drop immediately after first few tokens from eu-west. High volume of 499/502s from CDN logs, customers see partial outputs and then reconnect storms. Escalating.

Jade (support): Repro notes from a customer: websocket frames stop after 3-7 tokens, client sees a TCP RST; some clients report a trailing [DONE] missing. Also one customer reported duplicate token sequences after reconnect.

Samir (eng-sre): I can confirm spike in connection resets originating from our gw-eu-west LB pool starting ~08:12 UTC. Aggregated metrics: connection_close_by_peer + RST jumped x20. Initial hypothesis: kernel preemption on newer instance family causing keepalive timeouts -> abrupt socket closure.

Samir (eng-sre): Pasted log snippet from gw-eu-west-17: 
```
Mar 10 08:12:21 gw-eu-west-17 kernel: tcp: reset from 10.40.12.198:443 seq=0 ack=0 flags=RST
Mar 10 08:12:21 gw-eu-west-17 proxy: backend write failed: write tcp 10.40.12.198:443->10.40.99.21:52462: write: connection reset by peer
Mar 10 08:12:21 gw-eu-west-17 sse: client_id=prod-xx token_count=42 partial=true
```

Omar (infra-oncall): Confirmed. We started a kernel patch rollout to the eu-west pool yesterday to pick up a nic-driver fix; rollback queued. Rolling back now. Meanwhile mitigation options: 1) Reroute streaming traffic from gw-eu-west to gw-na-west for non-data-sensitive tenants (regional failover), 2) Serve fallback non-streaming long-poll endpoint to affected customers, 3) Increase nginx proxy_send_timeout + disable aggressive keepalive probe.

Nora (platform): I'm pushing a routing policy change to allow cross-region fallback for streaming for customers flagged as tolerant. Also enabling a temporary 'stream_fallback=true' flag in customer config which will make the SDK switch to polling: POST /v1/responses?stream=false.

Jade (support): For customer-facing guidance please give a short reproducible repro and suggested temporary client-side mitigations we can share in support tickets. Need a single-sentence status update for the status page too.

Samir (eng-sre): Repro steps we used (quick):
1) open websocket to wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=open-qa-eu
2) send start payload with large prompt (~3k tokens)
3) observe 3-7 tokens then socket close with RST.

Client repro using wscat:
```
# install wscat
wscat -c "wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=open-qa-eu&key=REDACTED"
> {"input": "explain x in detail...", "max_tokens": 1024}
# expected: streaming tokens; observed: RST after ~200-400ms
```

Samir (eng-sre): Quick internal checks: kernel rollback started on 3 nodes at 08:28, full rollback scheduled for 09:15. If rollback completes, we should see RST rates drop. If not, we’ll proceed with LB pool replacement.

Omar (infra-oncall): Implemented temporary LB route to push 15% of stream traffic to na-west as an emergency failover for a subset of customers (ID tag: stream-fallback-2026-03-10). Also toggled 'sse_strict_close' to false in the proxy which allows graceful close semantics instead of immediate RST for in-flight streams. Monitor in progress.

DeployBot: rollback/kernel-patch eu-west pool: started by Omar at 2026-03-10T08:28:43Z; status: in_progress

Samir (eng-sre): Observed immediate improvement on nodes where rollback finished — RST rate down ~70% on gw-eu-west-17 and -21. Still seeing some residual errors from certain CDNs that aggressively terminate idle websockets.

Nora (platform): For support responses: suggested text to customers — "We're investigating a regional SSE degradation in eu-west affecting streaming sessions. As a temporary workaround you can either 1) use the non-streaming endpoint by adding ?stream=false (no code change for SDK users who set stream:false), or 2) enable client reconnect/backoff: initial_backoff=250ms, max_backoff=8s and deduplicate tokens on reconnect. We're rolling a rollback and routing mitigation; we'll update within 1 hour."

Jade (support): Can we provide a small code snippet for client reconnect/dedup?

Samir (eng-sre): Quick client-side guidance: maintain last_received_token_index and on reconnect request with header `X-Resume-After: <index>`. If backend can't resume, fall back to non-streaming endpoint and reconcile partial output on client side. Example: 
```
// pseudo
const lastIndex = session.lastTokenIndex || 0;
ws = new WebSocket("wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=open-qa-eu");
ws.onmessage = (evt) => { handleToken(evt.data); session.lastTokenIndex++; };
ws.onclose = async () => {
  await backoff();
  fetch('/v1/responses?stream=false', {method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify({resume_after: lastIndex})});
};
```

Omar (infra-oncall): LB route and proxy flag changes are in. Keeping rollback to continue. Next steps: if rollback finishes and RST persists, we'll replace kernel package and temporarily shift eu-west streaming to a different instance class.

Samir (eng-sre): Monitoring notes: metrics to watch -> sse.rst_rate, sse.partial_output_count, lb.backend_write_errors, cdn.499_rate. Dashboards updated: incident board pinned.

DeployBot: rollback/kernel-patch eu-west pool: completed at 2026-03-10T09:07:12Z; status: success

Samir (eng-sre): Post-rollback: RST and partial-output alerts returned to baseline by 09:10 UTC. CDN 499s still showing small tail for ~10 minutes after rollback (expected due to cached connections).

Jade (support): Status page blurb — please use exact text for posting: "Investigating a regional SSE degradation impacting streaming sessions from eu-west. We have rolled back a recent kernel patch and applied temporary routing mitigations. Streaming has largely recovered; some customers may experience brief reconnects. Follow-up post in 30m."

Nora (platform): Added follow-up tasks: 1) schedule canary re-roll with extended socket stress tests, 2) add LB health probe that detects mid-stream RST anomalies, 3) add CDN cooperation ticket to investigate aggressive timeout behavior.

Jade (support): Thanks team — I’ll update customers with the workaround and status text. Closing escalation if we remain green for next 30m. :white_check_mark:
